evidence.domain_risk: Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. (TSX: CURA) (OTCQX: CURLF)... a leading international provider of consumer products in cannabis
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Curaleaf is a publicly traded company (TSX/OTCQX) in a heavily regulated industry (cannabis, subject to federal/state regulatory constraints as noted in the JD itself), an override to high domain risk on both financial-reporting and regulatory grounds.
